name: Corrupting Feast (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 15, Path of the Eternal Night

Benefit: The nightblade’s corruption lashes out at anyone who strikes at the nightblade, absorbing their life force. The nightblade is treated as if under the effects of a vampiric shadow shield spell as long as her corruption is active.
